node_input.distance_metric: Haversine great-circle distance in km on frozen centroid coordinates

process_scale_axis.reason: Published raccoon movement/dispersal estimates are not directly interchangeable with RABV grid-to-grid spread at this surveillance aggregation. The candidate is therefore not given a post-hoc biological threshold merely to create world diversity.

analyst_choice_structural_axis.construction: minimum Haversine distance threshold reaching each target largest weak component fraction, admitting tied distances together
analyst_choice_structural_axis.interpretation: response-blind structural coverage regimes only; not biological dispersal distances

structural_adequacy_declaration.reused_criterion: same scale-diversity criterion used prospectively in the Glanville structural gate
requirements: the 0.90 structural level achieves largest weak component fraction >= 0.90
the 0.90 structural level has isolated-node fraction <= 0.05
at least three distinct positive distance thresholds occur across the four 0.25/0.50/0.75/0.90 structural levels
thresholds and edge sets are nested and deterministic under frozen node geometry
structural_adequacy_declaration.reason_for_distinct_scale_requirement: The intended finite world universe must bracket meaningfully different local/intermediate/regional spatial regimes. If a regular grid causes all targets to collapse to one threshold, the generic scale ladder has not supplied the required structural world diversity for this independent prediction test.
structural_adequacy_declaration.stop_rule: If any requirement fails, stop before reading SurveillanceData.csv data rows. Do not replace the failed ladder with post-hoc k-nearest-neighbour, arbitrary distance, or response-tuned worlds.

secondary_axes.habitat_covariate_intersections: deferred until primary spatial scale certification passes
secondary_axes.ORV_management: not used to rescue a failed geography ladder; if later used, it belongs to a separately declared viability/management or analytical-world layer rather than being silently treated as dispersal distance

two_layer_prediction.latent_state: exact rule identities if Gate 1 passes

no_retuning: Do not alter target fractions, distinct-scale requirement, or add a biological distance after seeing this Gate 1 geometry result.
